HexKagune 1.0.10 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server; everyone on a server needs this jar.

**The final kakuja**
- **Naming.** The Centipede Form and the Full Kakuja are now called the *half kakujas*. War and Peace are the *final kakuja*.
- **The choice cards.** About five seconds after the Dragon ends, two cards come up: War and Peace. Click a card, then hold the button (or Enter) to choose. You choose once and are never asked again. "Decide later" or Esc closes the cards; until you choose, they come back at your next login, or click a FINAL KAKUJA row in the kagune menu to bring them up. Peace is still sealed: it opens when its abilities are done.
- **K.** Tap K to bring out the strongest half kakuja you have (the Full Kakuja once its quest is done, otherwise the Centipede Form). Tap again to go back out. Hold K to transform into your final kakuja; press K again to take it off. The old Y key is gone.
- **The menu changes with your choice.** Choose War and the kagune menu turns pure black with veins crawling through it. Choose Peace and it turns white with feathers. The menu also has a FINAL KAKUJA section and a K tap/hold legend.

**Peace's model, fixed**
- **No more floating blades.** Every cross blade is now held by its own kagune arm: a thicker tendril from the upper back with white armour plates, ending in four white claws that grip the blade's heart. These arms will carry Peace's attacks.
- **No more cut-off tendrils.** Every tendril of the wings now tapers to a point.

The model fixes were checked in offline renders made with the game's own model code, and the cards and menus in renders made with the game's own drawing code. The new K flow and the cards compile and pass the build's checks, but have not been tried in game yet. The build passes the full verifier and the dedicated-server check.
